en.html:
Hell?
Purgatory?
Or just the human world in miniature?

Depends who was looking. They would each give it a different name.
But what was happening here was one pure, simple thing. Whatever label you pasted on it, that part did not change.


People fought each other.
People killed each other.

People killed.
People died.

An ending.
A catastrophe.

en.html:
Ruin all around, and she was giving ruin her blessing.
More was coming. More was wanted. With that expectation, that wish, Chachamaru sang.

Like a devout tribal priest in an undeveloped land worshipping a god of destruction.
Like an old bishop in a great city's church offering holy words to the one God, full of despair and hatred.

Chachamaru Ashikaga said yes to this catastrophe.
Countless deaths, and her one soul was enough to want the whole lot, accept the whole lot. That was her boast.

Her form was crimson flame itself.
Red, darkly burning—the heat-haze of dusk. Dusk Flare.

—If the devil really existed,
then most probably it was standing in front of me only.

ja.html:
滅びの中で、滅びを<ruby>言祝<rt>ことほ</rt></ruby>ぎ。
　更なる滅びの到来を予期し、願って、茶々丸が<ruby>詩<rt>うた</rt></ruby>う。

　未開の地の敬虔な蛮族の<ruby>巫<rt>かんなぎ</rt></ruby>が破壊の神を祀るように。
　大都市の教会で年老いた司教が絶望と憎悪を込めて
唯一神への聖句を捧げるように。

　足利茶々丸は、この破局を肯定する。
　己の一個の魂がこの無数の死を欲し受け入れるのだ
と豪語する。

　その<ruby>形容<rt>かたち</rt></ruby>はまさに紅蓮。
　赤く昏く燃え盛る<ruby>夕闇の陽炎<rt>ダスクフレア</rt></ruby>。

　――悪魔が実在するとすれば。
　それは今、俺の前に立っているのだろう。

en.html:
Chachamaru and I watched the ending.

The silver meteor swarm swept through the heavens, wiping out the other stars—the warriors of the shogunate and the occupation army.
Up there, the most hideous struggle imaginable. Down here, see it from the ground only, and what a beautiful twilight dance the stars were having.

And one star shone more beautifully than all the rest. The fastest. The fiercest.

ja.html:
俺と茶々丸は終わりを見守る。

　白銀の流星群は天界を席巻し、もはや他の星を――
幕府や進駐軍の武者を――殲滅しつつある。
　凄惨極まる闘争劇は、地上から眺める限り、世にも
美しい黄昏の星々の舞踏会だった。

　そこに際立って麗しく輝くのは、最も速く猛き一星。

Chachamaru"And the other greatest power will arrive soon also."
Kageaki"And with that—"
Chachamaru"We break through the wall separating God from the surface. One hundred and fifteen kilometres of crust."
Chachamaru"God comes."
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"...What's the matter, bhai?"
Kageaki"Nothing."
Kageaki"We are calling this god for our own convenience. But what does the god have in mind, coming up here...?"
Kageaki"That was what I was thinking."
Chachamaru"...Who knows, yaar. Who can say?"
Chachamaru"Maybe the usual arrangement, na?"
Chachamaru"To atone for the sins of all humanity, perhaps."
